sv.title: Stockholm och Göteborg kan få samma järnväg till Oslo

en.title: Stockholm and Göteborg could get the same railway to Oslo
en.summary: The Swedish and Norwegian states have long considered the price tag for new and faster railways from Oslo to Stockholm and Oslo–Göteborg too high. To see whether the knot can be untied, Västsverige and Mälardalen are now joining forces to investigate whether a new, shared cross-border line could save billions and cut…
